config.description: The forest's root log id (R in /register/{R}/entries) when a call omits rootLogId.

config.description: Your authority log's creation grant, for issue_grant, register_grant and delegate_sealing as authority.

config.description: The registrar's sealer voucher key, base64 x||y, for delegate_sealing.

config.description: Directory for key files, grants, registrations and the spend ledger; default ~/.config/forestrie/mcp-register.

config.description: The one asset it pays in; default USDC on Base Sepolia. Required off the default network.
